preferences.text: Proposal, not approved guidance: explore contemporary, tactile domestic settings where architecture, circulation and light make room for pausing, connecting and participating again. Treat the draft guide and reference interiors as inspiration, not specifications.

The draft proposes warm neutrals with selected deeper or natural tones and tactile surfaces. These are exploratory relationships, not approved swatches, material specifications or a requirement to make every scene beige.

Official imagery shows a red symbol and uppercase DUROFLEX; treat this as observed identity, not a complete production specification. Confirm approved logo, lockup and typography rather than reconstructing them from draft slides.
Draft proposal: favor believable domestic actions and relaxed contact over presenter-like posing. Casting, wardrobe and gestures remain creative choices, not approved mandatory rules.
The official site shows varied category and promotional treatments. These are dated examples of current practice, not a permanent visual system or a requirement to imitate sale styling.

preserve: Keep the supplied strategy distinct from product efficacy proof; Motivating Reset and Designed to De-Stress express positioning, not verified product outcomes.
Retain truthful product identity and appearance in any future execution; reference-room furniture is not evidence of a Duroflex SKU.
Keep the Visual World Guide’s draft status visible. Its pages, including those labelled mandatory or approved, do not establish adopted rules.
explore: As proposals, explore usable domestic space, natural light, tactile surfaces and stories that move from pause toward connection or everyday participation.
Adapt any room, palette or category treatment to the exact selected product rather than imposing one look across the portfolio.
avoid: Do not treat draft-guide styling, reference images or current website campaigns as approved mandatory brand rules.
Do not invent exact fonts, colour values, production logo masters, approved portfolio names or product claims.
Do not imply medical, stress-treatment, recovery or quantified product effects from positioning language, poses or imagery.
unknowns: Production logo and tagline masters, approved typography and final identity lockups remain unresolved.
The draft guide’s environmental use of red is internally contradictory; do not infer permission from its examples.
No campaign, channel, selected SKU, approved claim set, offer or product-specific proof has been supplied for this task.
guide.decisionSummary: This is reusable Duroflex context, not an approved campaign brief. Preserve supported positioning and product truth; treat the visual guide and references as provisional inspiration. No mandatory visual execution rules are established here.
